failure_class: fixture setup (concurrent uploads), exposing a product finding
failure: 60 documents uploaded back-to-back into one KB (all 202). 28 of 60 reported status failed with 'executor error: Cannot COMMIT: Transaction conflict: Transaction write conflict. This transaction can be retried'; 32 indexed. The cleanup DELETE of the KB also hit the same conflict (500) while ingestion ran; it was deleted afterwards (204/404). Host config and embedding settings were never changed (setup failed first).
product_finding: IngestionRecord::failed_attempt marks the job Retryable (up to 5 attempts, 30s x attempts backoff), but transition (src/uar/persistence/providers/ingestion_records/surreal.rs:146-149) maps Retryable to DocumentStatus::Failed, so a document that will be retried is shown to the user as failed. Concurrent uploads into one KB cause the retryable Surreal write conflicts. Not fixed; reported to the operator.
next: Upload the corpus sequentially (wait for each document) and rerun once.
